ifuto-replay.config.title: Ifuto Replay Settings
ifuto-replay.config.hint: Default keys: R to record, M to add a marker. It stores the raw packet stream, so recording stays light (export FPS and resolution land in the next stage)
ifuto-replay.config.auto_record.tooltip: Start recording as soon as you join a world or server.
ifuto-replay.config.record_client_packet: Also store the packets you send to the server (movement, clicks, chat). Turning it off makes the file even smaller.
ifuto-replay.config.compression.tooltip: Compression runs on the writer thread, so it barely affects the game. Off: lightest. Fast: smaller. Balanced: smallest.
ifuto-replay.config.skip_keep_alive.tool: Leave out keep-alive and ping packets, which only keep the connection alive.
ifuto-replay.config.max_file_size.toolti: Stop and save automatically once the file grows past this. 0 means unlimited.
ifuto-replay.config.max_duration.tooltip: Stop and save automatically after this much time. 0 means unlimited.
ifuto-replay.config.show_indicator.toolt: While recording, show the elapsed time and file size in a screen corner.
ifuto-replay.config.indicator_position.t: Which corner the recording HUD sits in.
ifuto-replay.config.notify_chat.tooltip: Print recording start, save and marker messages to the chat.
ifuto-replay.message.not_in_game: §7[Replay]§r Join a world before starting a recording
ifuto-replay.message.io_error: §7[Replay]§r Could not open the save folder (check the save folder setting)
